description: Monthly unemployment rate for people under 25 (seasonally adjusted, % of the under-25 labour force) in one European country. Answers "how high is youth unemployment in Spain or Greece". Source: Eurostat dataset une_rt_m. Some countries publish youth figures only quarterly or with a lag, so recent months may be null; ask for 4 or more months. (cost: 1 credit)

geo.description: string, required, 2-letter Eurostat country code (DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL, EL = Greece) or country name; EU27_2020, EA (euro area), EA21, EA20 also accepted. EU, EFTA and EU candidate countries only (no UK)

n.description: integer, optional, most recent months, 1-100, default 12

name: eu_youth_unemployment_rate
